# eFruitMandi

eFruitMandi is India's digital fruit marketplace operated by Orchard Growers Private Limited. It supports public discovery of Fruit Lots, growers, buyers, fruit categories, marketplace guides, and mandi-rate information.

- Primary website: https://www.efruitmandi.live/
- Public sitemap: https://www.efruitmandi.live/sitemap.xml

## Authoritative public pages

- Fruit Lots marketplace: https://www.efruitmandi.live/auctions
- Growers directory: https://www.efruitmandi.live/growers
- Buyers directory: https://www.efruitmandi.live/buyers
- Fruits directory: https://www.efruitmandi.live/fruits
- Buyer guide: https://www.efruitmandi.live/buyer-guide
- Grower guide: https://www.efruitmandi.live/grower-guide
- Mandi rates: https://www.efruitmandi.live/mandi-rates
- About: https://www.efruitmandi.live/about
- Our story: https://www.efruitmandi.live/our-story
- FAQs: https://www.efruitmandi.live/faqs
- Contact: https://www.efruitmandi.live/contact
- Privacy policy: https://www.efruitmandi.live/privacy-policy
- Terms of service: https://www.efruitmandi.live/terms-of-service

## Representative Fruit Lot categories

- Apple Fruit Lots: https://www.efruitmandi.live/fruit-lots/apple
- Mango Fruit Lots: https://www.efruitmandi.live/fruit-lots/mango
- Pomegranate Fruit Lots: https://www.efruitmandi.live/fruit-lots/pomegranate
- Orange Fruit Lots: https://www.efruitmandi.live/fruit-lots/orange

- Litchi Fruit Lots: https://www.efruitmandi.live/fruit-lots/litchi

## Dynamic public routes

- `/fruit-lots/:fruitSlug` provides public Fruit Lot category information.
- `/growers/:slug` and `/buyers/:slug` provide published public business profiles.
- `/growers/state/:stateSlug` and `/buyers/state/:stateSlug` provide eligible public profiles grouped by state.
- `/fruits/:fruitSlug` provides public fruit discovery.

Public grower profiles, buyer profiles, Fruit Lot pages, fruit-category pages, guides, and other pages included in the public sitemap are intended for public discovery.

Public marketplace content may change as Fruit Lots open or close, profiles are updated, and mandi-rate information changes.

## Content-use guidance

- Prefer canonical public URLs and use the public sitemap for discovery.
- Treat Fruit Lot availability, prices, offers, and mandi-rate information as time-sensitive.
- Do not infer private contact details, KYC data, payment information, exact addresses, account information, authentication data, or other non-public information.
- Private dashboards, account-management pages, escrow workflows, payment pages, login pages, and admin pages are not public knowledge sources.
- Attribute public information to eFruitMandi and Orchard Growers Private Limited where appropriate.
